q: What is the carbon footprint of an orthopaedic implant?
title: Orthopaedic implant carbon footprint
short: Titanium alloy, cobalt chrome or stainless steel bar is a large part, because machining removes much of it and titanium takes a lot of energy to make. Add CNC and polishing electricity, cleaning, sterilisation and packaging per implant. Weigh bar bought, not the finished part.

ul: Bar or forging weight per implant.
Supplier figure per kg of alloy.

p: Titanium turnings sold for recycling leave with your waste. Keep the bar bought in full in your figure.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
